Evaluate a Classifier with Several Metrics

evaluate.Rd

Calculates the performance metrics of metrics in one call.

Usage

evaluate(
  y_true,
  y_pred = NULL,
  y_prob = NULL,
  metrics = NULL,
  average = "auto",
  positive = NULL,
  n_bins = 10
)

Arguments

y_true

factor of the true classes.

y_pred

predicted classes. If NULL, the class with the highest probability in y_prob is used.

y_prob

predicted class probabilities (matrix with one column per class, or for two classes a vector with the probability of positive). Needed for the probability based metrics.

metrics

character vector with the names of the metrics. The default NULL calculates all metrics that the inputs allow: without y_prob only the metrics based on predicted classes.

average, positive, n_bins

see metrics.

Value

a named numeric vector.

Details

The available metrics are ACC, BACC, F1, GMEAN, MCC, ROCAUC, PRAUC, Brier, PBrier, BBrier, ECE, BECE, P4, IAM, PRECISION, RECALL, SPECIFICITY, KAPPA and LOGLOSS. average is used by F1, P4, PRECISION, RECALL, SPECIFICITY, ROCAUC and PRAUC; the other metrics are defined for any number of classes.

Examples

set.seed(1)
y_true <- factor(sample(c("neg", "pos"), 200, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.9, 0.1)))
p_pos <- ifelse(y_true == "pos", rbeta(200, 3, 2), rbeta(200, 2, 4))
evaluate(y_true, y_prob = p_pos, positive = "pos")
#>         ACC        BACC          F1       GMEAN         MCC      ROCAUC 
#>   0.8300000   0.7855856   0.3928571   0.7838459   0.3726553   0.8580180 
#>       PRAUC       Brier      PBrier      BBrier         ECE        BECE 
#>   0.3387313   0.2759018   0.3609018   0.3367819   0.1215861   0.1082395 
#>          P4         IAM   PRECISION      RECALL SPECIFICITY       KAPPA 
#>   0.5471759   0.1061305   0.2682927   0.7333333   0.8378378   0.3179539 
#>     LOGLOSS 
#>   0.4386952 
evaluate(y_true, y_prob = p_pos, positive = "pos", metrics = c("MCC", "IAM", "BECE"))
#>       MCC       IAM      BECE 
#> 0.3726553 0.1061305 0.1082395
